feeds.title: Kidspot
feeds.description: Owned and operated by New Zealand mums, Kidspot is designed to be clean and intuitive, taking the hassle out of the search for parenting information - meaning parents can spend more quality time with their family as a result. Kidpsot has become New Zealand's most comprehensive online resource for parents, covering everything from conception through to the teenage years.

feeds.title: Kiwi Kids News
feeds.description: Kiwi Kids News is a company that provides an educational website for students, teachers and families. Kiwi Kids News aims to make the site student-friendly and safe while offering an entertaining environment, where students can find the latest news and current events.

feeds.title: It's Sarah Lilly
feeds.description: A lifestyle and personal style blog by Sarah Lilly. Sarah is a Kiwi solo mama successfully juggling motherhood, running her own business, and life - all while trying to remain sane (and stylish!)

feeds.title: Tots to Teens
feeds.description: Tots to Teens is a NZ based, ideas-driven magazine for the parents of 0 to 12 year-olds. They have regular nutrition, technology, financial and education-based articles; along with parenting and pregnancy/new baby information. They have book reviews (with book giveaways), book club giveaways, product reviews (with giveaways); as well.

feeds.title: Auckland for Kids Blog
feeds.description: Auckland for Kids is a trusted resource for families looking for things to do and places to go in Auckland, New Zealand with their children and teens. Founded by Carol Gernhoefer.

feeds.title: Caitlin Taylor Stylist
feeds.description: Chasing Cait is a Auckland-based personal styling business and everyday style blog helping you create confidence through style. With over 15 years in the fashion industry, Chasing Cait's Caitlin Taylor is passionate about making women feel good about themselves on the inside by making them confident on the outside.

feeds.title: The Confident Eater Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Judith, and I've seen first hand how stressful, exhausting and demoralising it can be living with a fussy eater.I'm also really, really passionate about food for children and would love to gift you the tools to gently transform meal get together and social occasions for your beloved. I love to write and this is the perfect space for me to share my knowledge and empower you.

feeds.title: Magpie Style Blog
feeds.description: Magpie Style is a personalised fashion and design store with expert advice on hand.Our mission is to help you look and feel your best in your clothes. We focus on long-distance dressing; buying clothes in high-quality fabrics that best suit your body-shape and life - designed to last years in your wardrobe.

feeds.title: Poetry Box
feeds.description: The blog is a New Zealand poetry page for children brought to you by Paula Green, who has published 11 books based on poetry.

feeds.title: Shared Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: Real food from scratch. Shared Kitchen is a good blog started by Julie Biuso. It is an ongoing collaboration between longtime New Zealand food personality Julie Biuso and upstart food blogger Ilaria Biuso.

feeds.title: Backyard Travel Family
feeds.description: Practice Advice for Active Families with children travelling around New Zealand. We want to help you explore the beauty and magic of New Zealand.

feeds.title: Mud Mates Blog
feeds.description: Join us as we have fun exploring different activities for kids of all ages. Fun, simple messy play, sensory play, science experiments, arts & crafts & more! Authored by Alana Steyn.

feeds.title: Kiwi Families
feeds.description: New Zealand's trusted parenting website for more than 10 years. We've been serving up free tips, tools and advice from some of the best New Zealand parenting experts, to help grow great families in New Zealand, and around the world.Kiwi Families is brought to you by us, Jarrod and Alayna (oh and our kids Saige and Maani make the odd appearance too!).

feeds.title: Mia Bella Passions
feeds.description: Mia Bella Passions is an Art, Home & Garden Blog created by award-winning New Zealand creative Tracey Lee Cassin.

feeds.title: Stitching Farmgirl
feeds.description: My quilting thoughts and inspirations sprinkled with a glimpse of life down on the farm. I'm Raewyn; a Mum to three grown children, Ganma to eight, and wife to a lovely dairy farmer {the MOML (man of my life)}. We live in Northland, New Zealand. I love the farm and my animals, my quilting, crafting, reading, blogging and much, much more.

feeds.title: The Natural Parent Magazine
feeds.description: The Natural Parent Magazine is the leading parenting magazine both online and in print, for conscious parents. Visit their blog where you'll find lots of nice bits and pieces including parenting support, pregnancy and birth, maternity fashion, parenting news, craft, photography, travel, events, and more.

feeds.title: She Moves Blog
feeds.description: We want to share our stories to help you understand yours - we hope you find inspiration and solidarity as we share the highs and lows of our wellness and motherhood journeys. Ren & Jen are mums to 5 preschoolers and are incredibly passionate about supporting mums to keep moving throughout pregnancy and return safely to exercise postpartum recovery. Both fully qualified in pre and postnatal exercise they have been described as having the 'go to' online workout classes for New Zealand mums.

feeds.title: The Nude Alchemist Blog
feeds.description: Helping families naturally with a skincare and body care range rooted in aromatherapy and herbalism since 2016. Our aromatherapist-formulated product range is proudly New Zealand-made, owned, operated, and endorsed by midwives, lactation and sleep consultants, and a huge number of families. Whilst utilising the gifts of the natural world, The Nude Alchemist is mindful of respecting Mother Nature and focused on minimising our impact on the environment.

feeds.title: Sarah Boughtwood Osteopath Blog
feeds.description: An osteopathic blog covering all health topics, ways to self manage and how an osteopath can help you. Sarah Boughtwood has her Bachelor of Applied Science majoring in Osteopathy and went on to complete her Masters in Osteopathy. She was drawn to becoming an osteopath after seeing the benefits of treatment to a wide variety of musculoskeletal issues.

feeds.title: Dr. Julie's Blog
feeds.description: See Dr Julie's famous mum's blog - covering everything from newborn baby content, healthy recipes, and content for new mums. On her website, you will find published books, helpful feeding products, her food range (Dr Julie's Kitchen), upcoming event details, free blogs and recipes, plus where to book for individualised advice. Internationally renowned, Dr Julie is on a mission to tackle the global health concerns affecting our families today - by nourishing children and parents, with evidence-based practical and realistic advice.

feeds.title: Just a Mum's Kitchen
feeds.description: I am Anna, a Mum to 3 children. This blog began as a way to store and share my recipes with family and friends as I was so often asked for recipes. It has become so much more. I have learnt so much about blogging, social media, building websites and every inch of this place has been created by me and a lot of googling for help!

feeds.title: Haakaa Blog
feeds.description: Haakaa is a New Zealand family-owned baby brand that provides parents with safe, natural, non-toxic and eco-friendly baby products online. We are 100% committed to creating stylish, practical and sustainable products that are safe for both our kids and our planet. Keep up to date with the latest news and products updates, tips for new parents and more!

feeds.title: Mod & Tod Blog
feeds.description: Mod & Tod is all about creating contemporary, beautiful and practical pieces so you can breastfeed with confidence and have a stress-free motherhood. Explore our mum blogs for more information on our products, tips for new mamas and babies, breastfeeding advice and more!

feeds.title: It's a Drama Blog
feeds.description: I'm Liz, and this is my family. I do Travel. I do Wine. I do homeschooling my teenagers. Sometimes I do all three at the same time. It's a Drama is a blog about how to brave changes- head on, how to jump into an adventure- big or small and live life to the fullest. How to travel the world, live differently, with some money or very little money.

feeds.title: Stamp Happy Blog
feeds.description: I am a mother of three daughters and servant to three fluffy cats. Born in the USA, I moved to New Zealand in 2005. Join us as we share our passion for all things papercraft and Stampin' Up! Projects, tutorials,Online classes and more!

feeds.title: Milkbar Blog
feeds.description: Be a part of our Milkbar Mums club, for Mum life chats, tips and tricks. We chat all things pregnancy, birth, lactation and general motherhood over on our Milkbar Mum Chat Podcast and on our blog. Milkbar is a New Zealand, family-owned and operated business based in the small coastal town of Raglan. Founding the company in 2017, Laura's vision was to Simplify Motherhood for mums and mums to be.

feeds.title: Angel Delivery Blog
feeds.description: The gift of a fresh meal, delivered to someone's home during a time of need, says love and care in all languages and cultures. This beautiful centuries-old tradition is what inspired Angel Delivery - we connect loved ones, by putting their love on table with gift hampers of handmade chilled meals, gourmet treats and stunning fresh flowers. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates, recipes, gifting toips and more!

feeds.title: Christen Peters Blog
feeds.description: Christen Peters is the Auckland Photographer capturing timeless, nostalgic images that you'll treasure forever. 35mm film & digital. Take a look through the blog for past sessions and tips & tricks for family photos.

feeds.title: Mom Store Blog
feeds.description: Find full of information for parents to help make those tricky decisions a little easier includine tips, guides, product comparisons + chats. Mom Store was founded in January 2021 and has been an absolute labour of love. I have personally curated [with the help from you guys along the way], the best of the best. The most trusted, loved + functional mum and baby products out.

feeds.title: Kiwi American Blog
feeds.description: New Zealand Lifestyle travel blogger Kiwiamerican moves her family of six to New Zealand from the USA over 8 years ago. Learn how to move to New Zealand, get a job in New Zealand, immigrate to New Zealand and how to set up life in New Zealand!

feeds.title: Stuck in the kitchen
feeds.description: Stuck in the Kitchen is a New Zealand-based food and recipe blog. Way back in 2013 I started this blog while working for Kiwi celebrity cook Annabel Langbein doing recipe development, styling and occasional photography. The blog is packed with all sorts of luscious feel good food, tips and photos.

feeds.title: Mum's Money New Zealand
feeds.description: Welcome to Mum's Money New Zealand where we love to talk money and share our best tips for making and saving money in New Zealand. Mum's Money New Zealand is an online money magazine designed to help New Zealanders find ways to save more money, pay down debt, increase income and live their best financial life.

feeds.title: Lila Jasmine Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Nurse, Midwife and Mother to bring you NZ's only Lactation Bar along with fourth-trimester workshops. Explore our blog for more tips and advice for breastfeeding mothers.

feeds.title: Happy Mum Happy Child Blog
feeds.description: My name is Maria. I started this website to document the activities I did with my children. That was in 2014 - now it has turned into this wee community for parents to come and feel less alone in this parenting journey.In my blog, I talk openly about my post natal depression, and about the experiences I have with day-to-day parenting.The rest of my website is dedicated to helping parents: activities for kids, recipes, tips and tricks, and so much more.

feeds.title: Queenstown Life
feeds.description: Queenstown Life is a lifestyle blog covering everything Queenstown, Wanaka, Beyond. Telling stories about brands and business alongside beautiful photography, quirky, fun language and making people feel local very very quickly.

feeds.title: Nature Library
feeds.description: I'm Kathy Broadhead (MEd, PGDipT, BSc), I am a qualified and experienced environmental educator with over 20 years working in a variety of education roles in NZ and abroad. I am passionate about collaborative learning between children, educator,s and nature. My programs combine child-led learning, free nature play, and intentional learning experiences to support the development of the whole child.

feeds.title: My Mummy Loves
feeds.description: I'm Clare. Originally from London, I'm now living in beautiful, Auckland, New Zealand where I work as a stylist, illustrator and influencer. Here you will find me talking about fashion (especially shoes and bags!), beauty, lifestyle, interiors and of course life with my children.

feeds.title: Lips n Berries
feeds.description: I'm Nishu. An expat Indian who calls New Zealand her home. This blog takes you through my motherhood journey, my love for natural skincare and not so natural makeup. I document our travels and share our experiences/tips/tricks with you here.

feeds.title: Waikato Foodbasket
feeds.description: Welcome to the Waikato Foodbasket! This is a blog about celebrating and showcasing the delicious abundance of the Waikato region. Authored by Alice Bulmer.

feeds.title: Baby Bliss Blog
feeds.description: At Baby Bliss I provide a personal consultation service, offering several services and sessions that cater for all parents needs from before your baby is born until your baby is 12 months old. Though my background is as a Midwife, I provide this service, not as your Midwife but rather as your Baby Advisor. Explore our advice, support and reassurance to mums.

feeds.title: Mothers Helpers Blog
feeds.description: Mothers Helpers supports evidenced-based prevention, treatment and recovery options for mothers suffering from Postnatal depression in New Zealand. Mothers Helpers is a Christian-based charity since the founder of Mothers Helpers Kristina Grace has a progressive Christian faith. Be informed of all aspects of wellbeing that have an affect on our mental health and receive helpful tips/advice.

feeds.title: Aotearoa Baby Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Explore resources, information and articles that will hopefully be helpful for you and your whanau. I'm Dr. Sophie. I'm a General Practitioner and Lactation Consultant (GP/LC) in Nelson/Tasman with a passion for helping babies and their parents thrive in the early years of life.

feeds.title: Give It a Burl
feeds.description: This is a blog about us deciding to sell our house, quit our jobs and move to Christchurch, New Zealand. Follow along with us on our adventures through New Zealand as a family.

feeds.title: Jessica Urlichs Blog
feeds.description: Jess's blog features published and unpublished motherhood poetry and prose. My name is Jess and I am an author and poet. I find writing extremely cathartic, and since sharing my words I now have a beautiful community of parents across my social channels, all here for the beautiful messy truth of motherhood.

feeds.title: Words of Emma Heaphy Blog
feeds.description: A blog filled with words of inspiration, motivation, truths and humour about pregnancy, motherhood and everything in between from one former family lawyer now a stay-at-home Kiwi mum. I'm Emma - a qualified lawyer, author and stay-at-home Mother of three. Through this site and my early motherhood poetry books, I share with you my experiences through the early years of motherhood.

feeds.title: On Bonn Blog
feeds.description: We write about sensory processing and other issues relating to skin, babywear and making comfortable, ethical and sustainable garments. On Bonn is a Kiwi children's clothing brand built on the knowledge that comfortable kids are happier, calmer, and sleep better. All our garments are made in New Zealand with beautiful ZQ Merino.

feeds.title: I am Balanced Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jacki, welcome to our healing space. I am a qualified Naturopath, Nutritionist and Medical Herbalist. I completed my nutrition degree at the University of Otago and my naturopathy and medical herbalist diploma at The Naturopathic College of New Zealand. We specialise in hormonal, fertility and skin health. This is a space for women to feel empowered, guided and safe. Find health tips, stories and more!

feeds.title: A Real Mum NZ Blog
feeds.description: A Real Mum NZ is home to everything REAL about motherhood, full of freebies and stress-saving products! Welcome to the reality of motherhood. I am Jorgiana, a young mum too one daughter! I love anything outdoors, animals, farming, anything where the air is fresh and cool! I love to write and always have so that is all manifested right here within my blog. Plus I am a total stationary geek too!

feeds.title: Home Grown Happiness
feeds.description: Hi, I am Elien. Welcome to Home Grown Happiness! Here it's all about homegrowing and homemaking food. Sourdough, gardening, preserving, cooking and baking.

feeds.title: The KitchenMaid
feeds.description: Welcome to The Kitchenmaid. This blog consists of food, recipes, meal inspiration, and stories from award-winning New Zealand journalist and food writer Lucy Corry.

feeds.title: She Said Yes
feeds.description: I'm Megan Hutchison, this is my home of all things wedding! I created this space in 2015 when we got engaged (and when I was blonde!), and it has grown as our relationship and family has grown. I share wedding advice and help couples plan their wedding.

feeds.title: Becoming Mum Blog
feeds.description: I'm a 30 something-year-old Mum of 2 living in Wellington, New Zealand. It all started when I decided to start a blog to document my first pregnancy, a few posts went viral and it all went downhill from there. Follow along to get notified about motherhood and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Natalie Brady Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nat, a Registered Clinical Nutritionist & holistic health blogger. I have a HUGE passion to help empower women and men to feel happy, confident and live the healthy balanced life you deserve! It's my mission to help you learn that healthy living should be fun, rewarding, enjoyable and NOT boring, difficult or feel like a chore.

feeds.title: Empowermums Blog
feeds.description: I am Dr Missy Wolfman, a mum of twin girls and a Clinical Psychologist. I started EmpowerMums because I found adjusting to motherhood with two babies challenging. It became my passion to share with other mothers the strategies and techniques I am currently using in my own life. Discover practical tips to help you reclaim time as a busy mom.

feeds.title: Bella Mama Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on our latest blogs, written in mind for mamas like you! At Bella Mama everything we do supports the very type of mother and woman you are. We have consciously created a variety of offers including treatments, workshops, classes and products to support, nourish and care for you.
